svg.title: Forms, entry by entry
svg.desc: Dot matrix of the Committee's bibliography entries in order of year (1981-2025) against eleven form tags: ink squares where the book's own line names the form, red rings where only the Committee's essay does. Educational demos made to show an open-source tool. Not research.
